subject: phase3_requests_cumulative_context_retest
statement: Close the bounded Requests retest as positive cost-containment evidence but reject the common 16-call boundary as sufficient for Phase 3 expansion because direct mode could not reserve post-patch verification and full mode produced an evaluator-incompatible candidate test change.
selected_option: retain all three terminal outcomes, keep Phase 3 expansion unauthorized, and require a provider-free role-aware verification reserve plus a preregistered benchmark candidate-test policy before another scored instance

alternatives.option: accept the common 16-call policy and proceed directly to a new SWE-EVO instance
alternatives.rejected_reason: Direct mode exhausted all 16 admitted tools after editing and returned a failed result without post-patch verification.

alternatives.option: raise the common hard limit immediately from this single sample
alternatives.rejected_reason: One Requests repetition does not calibrate a general fixed limit, and a larger undifferentiated boundary would weaken the containment result without reserving verification explicitly.

alternatives.option: strip the full-mode test hunk after execution and report an official quality score
alternatives.rejected_reason: Post-hoc candidate mutation is outside the frozen protocol and would invalidate the scored result.

rationale: The retest completed all three serial modes with 100 percent provider-usage coverage and 853231 aggregate tokens, 59.7962 percent below the retained 2122262-token historical baseline and 71.9525 percent below the previous 3042089-token treatment screen. Single used 201242 tokens and 8 tools. Direct used 259457 tokens and exactly 16 tools, but its worker correctly failed because the hard boundary arrived before post-patch tests; no candidate was integrated and the evaluator classified the empty submission as candidate_patch_invalid. Full used 392532 tokens across a 4-tool author and 15-tool worker, passed common acceptance, and emitted a substantive production fix, but its added test overlapped the evaluator-only test patch and was rejected as evaluator_patch_conflict. Cost containment is therefore demonstrated on this historical control, while end-to-end quality and the shared hard-limit policy are not accepted.
expected_outcome: Use the retained run to design and provider-free verify a role-aware budget that protects final verification and a benchmark candidate-test policy that remains fixed before model execution; do not claim a quality improvement from this run.
